ask: Research existing mechanisms that route timing belts (GT2 or similar) through orthogonal corners — CoreXY/H-Bot 3D printer gantry designs, robotic joint drives, multi-axis CNC belt feeds. Extract the geometric parameters: belt crossing angles at corners, idler pulley diameters and positions, belt tensioning methods, and clearance envelopes. Then build a parameterized geometric model of three orthogonal GT2 belt loops on a 60mm cube frame showing belt paths, corner pulley positions, and crossing clearances at every rotation angle — verify no two belts occupy the same space. Target: a concrete corner-pulley layout (diameters, bore spacing, belt gap at crossing) that a 3D-printable corner block can realize.
